title: ts#website#auth#idp
description: Add an external OpenID Connect identity provider to the Cognito sign-in that ts#website#auth vends. Run it once per identity provider.

examples.description: Let users sign in to the website through Okta

name.description: The identity provider name, 3-32 letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Cognito shows it on the sign-in button and prefixes federated usernames with it
name.x-prompt: What name should the identity provider have? (for example Okta)

issuerUrl.description: The identity provider's OIDC issuer URL, exactly as it appears in the iss claim of its tokens. Must use https://
issuerUrl.x-prompt: What is the identity provider's issuer URL?

clientId.description: The client ID of the application registered at the identity provider
clientId.x-prompt: What is the client ID of the application registered at the identity provider?

clientSecretName.description: The name of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that holds the client secret. Defaults to <name>-oidc-client-secret

scopes.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes to request from the identity provider. Must include openid

attributeMapping.description: JSON object mapping Cognito user pool attributes to identity provider claims. Must map email, given_name and family_name

identifiers.description: Comma-separated identifiers, such as email domains, that Cognito can use to send a user to this identity provider

iac.description: The preferred IaC provider. By default this is inherited from your initial selection.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: inherit)
